import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a bar chart to compare transaction types for fraudulent and non-fraudulent transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud)
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution for Fraudulent and Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
